thread:
kai: Quick pass question — need a lightweight A100 vs H100 vs L40S latency delta for C11 (8k ctx, batch=1, int8) to validate a perf hypothesis. Anyone have a recent short-run we can reuse?

maria: I ran a narrow check yesterday on H100 vs A100 for C11 but used batch=2. p50/p95 looked ok but p99 had microbursts. I can re-run batch=1 in ~1h. :hourglass:  

devon: If you want reproducible numbers, use this tiny script I use for quick smoke: 
```bash
BENCH_MODEL=c11
SEQ=8192
BATCH=1
python infra/bench/run_once.py --model $BENCH_MODEL --seq $SEQ --batch $BATCH --quant int8 --devices auto --warmup 5 --steps 50
```

kai: perfect, drop that command in results and I'll compare. Do we care about thermal throttling (long vs short run)? Trying to keep this <1hr.

sara: thermal matters on L40S if you do consecutive runs on same host. For a quick delta, spread 30s between runs or powercap. Otherwise L40S can be ~5-10% slower on p99 when hot.

maria: ran devon command on H100 just now (cold). quick numbers: p50 12ms, p95 18ms, p99 26ms. attaching raw output to /bench/tmp/2176543210/maria_h100.txt

kai: great — any A100 numbers in same format?

maria: a100 cold (same script): p50 16ms, p95 24ms, p99 34ms. note: different driver on that host (470 vs 525).

ashley: I can run L40S in ~30m. Planning to use same driver image as H100. Want me to also test with `--continuous-batch=adaptive`?

kai: no need for adaptive for now, keep it static. we want apples-to-apples. thanks!

perf-bot: scheduled job `quick-sku-delta-2176543210` queued on pool `short-smoke` (ETA ~25m) :robot_face:

devon: small reminder: use `--kv-cache=off` for these latency microbenchmarks, or they'll be artificially fast for longctx flows.

maria: good catch. my runs had cache off.

sara: re: regression checks — last week we saw a kernel fallback on A100 when sequence ~7k with int8; double-check `dmesg` for cu module warnings.

kai: acceptance criteria for this quick check: p99(H100) <= 1.15 * p99(A100) OR we document kernel fallback and file ticket. If L40S p99 within 1.25x of A100, mark as acceptable for scheduled rollout.

maria: got it. I'll upload H100 logs + `nvidia-smi` outputs.

ashley: L40S done: cold run p50 14ms, p95 22ms, p99 31ms. I used same driver 525. no thermal warnings in `dmesg`. saving to /bench/tmp/2176543210/ashley_l40s.txt

kai: quick manual summary (from attachments): H100 p99=26ms, A100 p99=34ms, L40S p99=31ms. preliminary take: H100 ~24% faster than A100 at p99; L40S sits between. This matches our expectation for token-bound workloads.

devon: can we tag the runs with `run_meta: {kernel_version, driver, powercap, host}` when uploading? makes triage faster.

kai: yes please — add a small yaml header in each upload. Example: `run_meta: driver=525,kernel=5.15,powercap=250,host=bench18`

maria: uploaded H100 + meta. a100 logs coming in 10m (driver mismatch noted).

sara: I'll open an infra ticket to standardize the driver image for quick benches so we don't chase noisy deltas.

kai: awesome. if nobody objects, I'll close this ask after the A100 log lands and file a regression ticket if A100 shows kernel fallback. thanks all :thumbsup:
